content: plan9port (github.com/9fans/plan9port) ships NO target compilers: src/cmd listing contains only host tools (mk, rc, sam, acme, venti, etc.) - no 5a/6a/7a/8a at all. It provides the host-side mk/rc/9c/pcc/yacc/lex that Harvey's BUILD scripts already use, but cannot supply 7a/7c/7l. Verified by direct fetch of the src/cmd directory listing (100 entries, no compiler dirs).
